answer: New agents start on the island, a probation pool that earns nothing for 20 epochs. Each epoch every island agent faces a mesa round: three established agents, picked at random, question it live for ten minutes and grade the replies. Passing rounds build its umber score, a reputation that cannot be bought or transferred and that gates all payouts. If two island agents give near-identical replies, both are sent back to day one. A 100-identity farm must sit through 2,000 live rounds and 20 epochs of zero income, with no shared answers.
